browser_adopted_additions.current_progress_rule: The current M14 checkpoint and work records govern progress. The handoff inspected an older M13 checkpoint; its historical progress wording is provenance, not a restore target or a reset of newer work.
browser_adopted_additions.sequence_rule: M15 remains the earliest existing unassigned milestone. The recommended browser batch requires a separate coherent assignment; formal predecessor gates remain mandatory and no prior milestone is skipped or accepted.

browser_adopted_additions.origin_recommended_worker_instruction: Adopt the attached browser-Clef architecture update at your current Rifare branch head. Preserve newer work, the implemented M13 path, all M00–M22 requirements and original gates. Add M23–M25 through a second frozen requirement set and the existing exact-union planning validation; do not reimport the old roadmap or rebuild M13. Merge ARCHITECTURE.md using the included patch as a comparison aid. After integrating the current coherent assignment, implement M23-G01 through M23-G05 under our existing delegation. Start with pinned Kevala/Clef Flash Q8 text/JSON in the operator browser. Reuse the logical contracts through a browser-safe layer, keep client observations explicitly untrusted, and preserve server authority and hosted provenance. Keep local-to-hosted fallback explicit. Follow the current focused-development policy and record actual browser/model qualification separately from fixtures. Return the updated checkpoint, actual evidence and remaining qualification.
